  pointer-events: auto;
  animation-timing-function: var(--spring) !important;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 8px 8px 8px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r);
  background: var(--text);
  color: var(--text-inv);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  animation: toastIn 0.2s var(--ease) both;
  max-width: 400px;
}
.toast.out {
  animation: toastOut 0.16s ease both;
}
.toast .i.ok {
  color: var(--green);
}
.toast .i.bad {
  color: var(--red);
}
.toast .ta {
  color: var(--text-inv);
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  opacity: 0.9;
}
.toast .ta:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-inv) 14%, transparent);
}
@keyframes toastIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(14px) scale(0.96);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes toastOut {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(4px);
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   STATES: EMPTY / SKELETON / ERROR
   ============================================================ */
.empty-state {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 56px 24px;
  gap: 6px;
}
.empty-state .glyph {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--text-4);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.empty-state .glyph svg {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
}
.empty-state .es-h {
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0;
}
.empty-state p {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  max-width: 340px;
}
.empty-state.sm {
  padding: 28px 16px;
}
.empty-state.err .glyph {
  color: var(--red);
}
.sk {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--surface-3) 0%, var(--surface-2) 45%, var(--surface-3) 90%);
  background-size: 220% 100%;
  animation: shimmer 1.3s ease-in-out infinite;
  border-radius: 5px;
  display: block;
}
@keyframes shimmer {
  from {
    background-position: 120% 0;
  }
  to {
    background-position: -100% 0;
  }
}
.alert {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  align-items: flex-start;
  background: var(--surface);
}
.alert .i {
  margin-top: 1px;
}
.alert.warn {
  background: var(--amber-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.warn .i {
  color: var(--amber);
}
.alert.danger {
  background: var(--red-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.danger .i {
  color: var(--red);
}
.alert.info {
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.info .i {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.alert.ok {
  background: var(--green-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.ok .i {
  color: var(--green);
}
.alert b {
  font-weight: 600;
}
.fullstate {
  min-height: 100%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 40px 20px;
}
.fullstate .box {
  max-width: 420px;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.fullstate .code {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-3);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
.fullstate h1 {
  font-size: var(--fs-xl);
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}
.fullstate p {
  color: var(--text-2);
  margin: 0 0 12px;
}
/* ============================================================
   SETTINGS
   ============================================================ */
.set {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr);
  height: 100%;
}
.set-nav {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 20px 10px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--surface);
}
.set-nav .gh {
  font-size: var(--fs-2xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-3);
  padding: 14px 8px 4px;
}
.set-nav .gh:first-child {
  padding-top: 0;
}
.set-body {
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.set-in {
  max-width: 720px;
  padding: 32px 40px 80px;
}
.set-in h1 {
  font-size: var(--fs-xl);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}
.set-in > p.lead {
  color: var(--text-2);
  margin: 0 0 24px;
}
.srow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 24px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 14px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
}
.srow .t {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: var(--fs);
}
.srow .d {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.sblock {
  margin-top: 28px;
}
.sblock > h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.themecards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.tcard {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 8px;
  text-align: left;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur),
    box-shadow var(--dur);
}
.tcard:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.tcard.on {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft);
}
.tprev {
  height: 84px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 30% 1fr;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.2);
}
.tprev .s {
  padding: 8px 6px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.tprev .m {
  padding: 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
}
.tprev i {
  display: block;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.swatches {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sw {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  transition: transform var(--dur);
}
.sw:hover {
  transform: scale(1.08);
}
.sw.on {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 2px var(--surface),
    0 0 0 4px var(--c);
}
.perm-t {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
}
.perm-t th,
.perm-t td {
  padding: 9px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
  text-align: center;
}
.perm-t th:first-child,
.perm-t td:first-child {
  text-align: left;
}
.perm-t th {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.plan {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.plan.cur {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft);
}
.plan .pr {
  font-size: var(--fs-xl);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}
.plan ul {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.plan li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 7px;
  align-items: center;
}
.plan li .i {
  color: var(--green);
}
.meter {
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--surface-3);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.meter i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--accent);
}
/* ============================================================
   AUTH / ONBOARDING
   ============================================================ */
.auth {
  min-height: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--bg);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.auth-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 18px 24px;
}
.brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: var(--fs-md);

/* ============================================================
   MOTION: one-shot flow animations (gated to the render they belong to)
   ============================================================ */
@keyframes riseIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes slideInR {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(18px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes growX {
  from {
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }
}
@keyframes popCheck {
  0% {
    transform: scale(0.55);
  }
  55% {
    transform: scale(1.2);
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}
@keyframes strike {
  to {
    background-size: 100% 1.5px;
  }
}
@keyframes doneWash {
  from {
    background: var(--green-soft);
  }
  to {
    background: transparent;
  }
}
@keyframes doneRing {
  from {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 2px var(--green),
      var(--shadow-card);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
@keyframes land {
  0% {
    transform: scale(1.04) rotate(-1.2deg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-drag);
  }
  100% {
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
@keyframes addWash {
  from {
    background: var(--accent-soft);
  }
  to {
    background: transparent;
  }
}
@keyframes addRing {
  from {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 2px var(--accent-line),
      var(--shadow-card);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
/* route change: content rises in, lightly staggered */
.fx-route > .page > *,
.fx-route > .fullstate {
  animation: riseIn 0.36s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.035s;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.07s;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.1s;
}
.fx-route .grid2 > * > *:nth-child(2),
.fx-route .grid2 > *:nth-child(2) > *:first-child {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s 0.09s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .prog > i {
  animation: growX 0.8s 0.12s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .stackbar i {
  transform-origin: left;
  animation: growX 0.8s 0.12s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .bar {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.pbody.fx-tab > * {
  animation: riseIn 0.26s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .kcard {
  animation: riseIn 0.32s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(2) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.03s;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(3) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.06s;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(n + 4) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.09s;
}
/* task completed */
.trow.fx-done,
.mini.fx-done {
  animation: doneWash 1s var(--ease) both;
}
.kcard.fx-done {
  animation: doneRing 1s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-done .check,
.fx-done .done-ic {
  animation: popCheck 0.42s var(--spring) both;
}
.fx-done .tt,
.fx-done .title {
  text-decoration: none !important;
  background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 0 58%/0 1.5px no-repeat;
  animation: strike 0.38s 0.1s var(--ease) forwards;
}
/* dropped, created */
.kcard.fx-moved {
  animation: land 0.5s var(--spring) both;
}
.cev.fx-moved,
.wcard.fx-moved {
  animation: popCheck 0.4s var(--spring) both;
}
.trow.fx-added,
.mini.fx-added {
  animation:
    riseIn 0.3s var(--ease) both,
    addWash 1.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.kcard.fx-added {
  animation:
    riseIn 0.3s var(--ease) both,
    addRing 1.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.subt.fx-added {
  animation: riseIn 0.28s var(--ease) both;
}
/* auth + onboarding */
.auth-card.fx-auth > * {
  animation: riseIn 0.42s var(--ease) both;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.04s;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.08s;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.12s;
}
.onb.fx-step > *:not(.steps) {
  animation: slideInR 0.36s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.05s;
}
.steps i {
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: background 0.3s;
}
.onb.fx-step .steps i.cur {
  animation: growX 0.45s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.12s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.24s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row .ok {
  animation: popCheck 0.42s var(--spring) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(1) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.18s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(2) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.3s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(3) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.42s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-badge {
  animation: popCheck 0.5s 0.05s var(--spring) both;
}
/* tactile micro-feedback */
.check:active {
  transform: scale(0.88);
}
.check {
  transition:
    background var(--dur),
    border-color var(--dur),
    transform 0.12s var(--ease);
}
.toggle::after {
  transition: transform 0.28s var(--spring);
}
.pcard {
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur),
    box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease),
    transform 0.2s var(--ease);
}
.pcard:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.kcard {
  transition:
    box-shadow var(--dur),
    transform 0.18s var(--ease);
}
.kcard:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.stat .v {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .fx-route > .page > *,
  .fx-route > .fullstate,
  .fx-route .grid2 > * > *,
  .fx-route .bar,
  .pbody.fx-tab > *,
  .pbody.fx-tab .kcard,
  .auth-card.fx-auth > *,
  .onb.fx-step > *,
  .drawer.enter .drawer-b > *,
  .kcard.fx-moved,

  .fx-done .check,

  .fx-route .prog > i,

  }

  .pcard:hover,

  .check:active {

  }
}

:root[data-motion='reduce'] .pbody.fx-tab > *,

/* ============================================================
   QUIRE — DESIGN TOKENS
   Light palette on bare :root; dark redefined (not inverted).
   ============================================================ */
:root {
  /* surfaces */
  --bg: #fbfaf8;
  --bg-side: #f4f3f0;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f6f5f2;
  --surface-3: #eeede9;
  --sunken: #f7f6f3;
  --overlay: rgba(24, 22, 19, 0.28);
  /* lines */
  --border: #e9e7e2;
  --border-strong: #dad7d0;
  --divider: #f0eeea;
  /* text */
  --text: #1d1c1a;
  --text-2: #57544e;
  --text-3: #6b6760;
  --text-4: #8c8880;
  --text-inv: #ffffff;
  /* accent (swappable) */
  --acc-l: #4b5bd6;
  --acc-d: #8e9af3;
  --accent: var(--acc-l);
  --on-accent: #ffffff;
  --accent-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent);
  --accent-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 38%, transparent);
  /* semantic */
  --green: #25754b;
  --amber: #8f5e0e;
  --red: #b23c30;
  --blue: #3570c4;
  --violet: #7652c2;
  --teal: #1e8580;
  --rose: #bc4270;
  --orange: #c0612b;
  --gray: #8a867e;
  --green-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--green) 11%, transparent);
  --amber-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 12%, transparent);
  --red-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 10%, transparent);
  /* status */
  --st-backlog: #a29e96;
  --st-todo: #7c7870;
  --st-progress: #c88a14;
  --st-review: #7652c2;
  --st-done: #2e8456;
  /* elevation */
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 25, 20, 0.05);
  --shadow-card: 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 25, 20, 0.04), 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
  --shadow-pop: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(28, 25, 20, 0.16), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(28, 25, 20, 0.06), 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
  --shadow-drag: 0 16px 36px -10px rgba(28, 25, 20, 0.28), 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong);
  /* radius */
  --r-xs: 4px;
  --r-sm: 6px;
  --r: 8px;
  --r-lg: 10px;
  --r-full: 999px;
  /* spacing (4pt scale) */
  --s-1: 4px;
  --s-2: 8px;
  --s-3: 12px;
  --s-4: 16px;
  --s-5: 20px;
  --s-6: 24px;
  --s-8: 32px;
  --s-10: 40px;
  --s-12: 48px;
  /* type */
  --font: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  --mono: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  --fs-2xs: 11px;
  --fs-xs: 12px;
  --fs-sm: 12.5px;
  --fs: 13.5px;
  --fs-md: 14.5px;
  --fs-lg: 16px;
  --fs-xl: 19px;
  --fs-2xl: 23px;
  /* component sizes */
  --h-xs: 22px;
  --h-sm: 26px;
  --h-md: 30px;
  --h-lg: 36px;
  --side-w: 252px;
  --side-row: 30px;
  --row-h: 40px;
  --card-pad: 10px;
  --topbar-h: 46px;
  /* one horizontal content edge shared by breadcrumb, page headers, toolbars, lists, tables and boards */
  --gutter: 24px;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
  --ease-drawer: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  --dur: 140ms;
  color-scheme: light;
}

    color-scheme: dark;

}

  --bg: #1a1a19;

  --amber: #d8a443;
  --red: #e57d70;
  --blue: #72a5ea;
  --violet: #a98deb;

  --rose: #e68aab;
  --orange: #e3925f;
  --gray: #8f8b84;
  --pc-mix: 72%;

  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  --shadow-card: 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
  --shadow-pop: 0 16px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong);
  --shadow-drag: 0 18px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong);
  color-scheme: dark;
}
/* accent variants */
:root[data-accent='blue'] {
  --acc-l: #2f6cd4;
  --acc-d: #74a7f0;
}
:root[data-accent='violet'] {
  --acc-l: #7348cc;
  --acc-d: #ae93f0;
}
:root[data-accent='teal'] {
  --acc-l: #1a7f7a;
  --acc-d: #5cc4ba;
}
:root[data-accent='rose'] {
  --acc-l: #b93d68;
  --acc-d: #ec8dae;
}
:root[data-accent='graphite'] {
  --acc-l: #34332f;
  --acc-d: #d9d6cf;
}

}
